parameters.name: ActionType
parameters.description:
The scenario in which the image is used. Valid values:

- CreateEcs (default): creates an instance.
- ChangeOS: replaces the system disk or changes the operating system.

parameters.name: Architecture
parameters.description: The architecture of the image. Valid values:

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run for the request.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The list of filter conditions for querying resources.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The filter key used to query resources. Valid values:

- CreationStartTime: queries information about resources that are created after the point in time specified by Filter.N.Value.
- CreationEndTime: queries information about resources that are created before the point in time specified by Filter.N.Value.
- NetworkType: queries information about resources of the specified network type.
- CpuOnlineUpgrade, CpuOnlineDowngrade, MemoryOnlineUpgrade, or MemoryOnlineDowngrade: queries the CPU or memory hot-plugging support of the specified image.

Default value: null.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The filter value used when querying resources.
- When Filter.N.Key is `CreationStartTime` or `CreationEndTime`, the format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` in the UTC+0 time zone.
- When Filter.N.Key is `NetworkType`, you can specify network type values such as `vpc` and `classic`.

- When Filter.N.Key is set to `CpuOnlineUpgrade`, `CpuOnlineDowngrade`, `MemoryOnlineUpgrade`, or `MemoryOnlineDowngrade`, the value can be `supported` or `unsupported`.

Default value: null.

parameters.name: ImageFamily
parameters.description:
The image family name. You can set this parameter to filter images that belong to the specified image family.

Default value: null.
> For information about image families associated with Alibaba Cloud official images, see [Public image overview](~~108393~~).

parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description:
The image ID.

<details>
<summary>Naming conventions for image IDs</summary>

- Public image: Named based on the operating system version, architecture, language, and release date. For example, the image ID of a Windows Server 2008 R2 Enterprise Edition 64-bit English image is win2008r2_64_ent_sp1_en-us_40G_alibase_20190318.vhd.

- Custom image, shared image, Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image, and community image: Starts with m.

</details>

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description: The name of the image. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: ImageOwnerAlias
parameters.description: The source of the image. Valid values:

parameters.name: ImageOwnerId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the image belongs. This parameter takes effect only when you query shared images or community images.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The instance type for which you want to query available images.

parameters.name: IsPublic
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query published community images. Valid values:

- true: Queries published community images. If you set this parameter to true, you must set ImageOwnerAlias to others.
- false: Queries image types other than community images. The specific image type depends on the value of ImageOwnerAlias.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: IsSupportCloudinit
parameters.description: Specifies whether the image supports cloud-init.

parameters.name: IsSupportIoOptimized
parameters.description: Specifies whether the image can run on I/O optimized instances.

parameters.name: OSType
parameters.description: The operating system type of the image. Valid values:

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the image resources.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Settings for paging determine how many rows are returned per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the image. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the enterprise resource group to which the custom image belongs. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the number of resources cannot exceed 1,000.

>Default resource group-based filtering is not supported.

parameters.name: ShowExpired
parameters.description: Specifies whether the subscription image has expired.

parameters.name: SnapshotId
parameters.description: The ID of the snapshot used to create the custom image.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the image. Valid values:

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the image. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the image. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the image.

sub_parameters.name: value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the image.

>This parameter will be deprecated. To improve compatibility, use Tag.N.Value instead.

parameters.name: Usable
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the image is available.
>An available image can be used immediately to create instances. For more available scenarios, see [Snapshot instant access](~~3044728~~).

parameters.name: Usage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the image is running on an ECS instance. Valid values:

- instance: The image is in use by an ECS instance.
- none: The image is idle and not in use by any ECS instance.
